# Run a Season

> **Who this is for:** BOOKER or ADMIN for creating seasons and booking their shows; ADMIN only for the Season Settings screen (schedule generation, boundaries, fan recalibration).

A booker's guide to seasons — the yearly frame that groups shows, awards, and wrestler histories into chapters you can look back on.

**What a season gives you:** a container for your promotion's year (its shows, its champions, its milestones), per-wrestler season histories for the record books, and an auto-generated show schedule so the calendar fills itself.

---

## Step 1 — Create the season

Open **Season List** from the navigation and click **Add Season**. Give it a name (and the year or episode numbering your promotion uses). The season starts as the **active season** — new shows you create default into it.

![Season list](/screenshots/booker-season-list.png)

---

## Step 2 — Generate the schedule (optional but recommended)

Under **Season Settings**, the **Generate Season Schedule** button builds a season's worth of shows automatically:

1. Open **Season Settings** and click **Generate Season Schedule**.
2. The game lays out the season's shows — weekly TV, premium live events — as **Scheduled** entries on the calendar, following your show templates.
3. Confirm when prompted; the settings page shows the schedule before and after.

![Season settings — after generation](/screenshots/admin-season-settings-after-generation.png)

Generate early: tournaments with a **Host Show** binding and annual editions pace their rounds against upcoming shows, so a full calendar gives them somewhere to land.

---

## Step 3 — Run the shows

The season now runs exactly like normal booking — see [Schedule a Show](./schedule-a-show) for the per-show loop. Season membership is automatic: shows created while a season is active belong to it, and their results feed the season's story.

As the season progresses:

- **Wrestler snapshots** record each wrestler's fan count at season start — the baseline for season-end awards and historical performance.
- **Season awards** accrue on the season's detail page as milestones are hit.

![Season detail](/screenshots/booker-season-detail.png)

---

## Step 4 — Read the record books

Two places tell the season's story after the fact:

- **Season Detail** — the season's awards and achievements with dates.
- **Player Dashboard** — each player-controlled wrestler's **season history** and **season summary** (start vs end fans, peak moments), so players see their own arc across the year.

![Season summary](/screenshots/player-season-summary.png)

---

## Step 5 — Close it out and start the next

When the season's calendar is exhausted, create the next season and it becomes active — previous seasons stay browsable in the Season List with everything attached.

> 💡 **Seasons and universes:** seasons belong to your universe's continuity. If you run several universes (see [Manage Universes](./manage-universes)), each keeps its own seasons.

---
